verdict.rationale: The product documents a choice between its standard Jobs transcription and a faster Edge mode for short audio, publishes accuracy results, and lists per-minute pricing. However, no evidence shows a menu of named models with side-by-side accuracy, latency, and cost tradeoffs. missing for 10: a documented list of selectable transcription models, per-model accuracy figures, published latency numbers, per-model or per-mode pricing, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among documented transcription models with published accuracy, latency, and cost tradeoffs

citations.quote: Use faster edge transcription for supported short-audio workflows.
Published accuracy results help people evaluate transcription performance before integrating.
The Edge API transcribes short files synchronously
